posts.text: I attended LarpHacks at the University of Toronto’s Bahen Centre this weekend, and I’m grateful for the experience. In roughly seven hours, our team built Larpslator, a context-aware live speech translator that converts Korean speech into English. General-purpose translators often mistranslate specialized terms.
